entities.name: Monastery of Saint Archangel Gabriel
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Monastery of Saint Archangel Gabriel, also known as the Zemun monastery is a Serbian Orthodox monastery. Its church was built in 1786, on the site of an older church in the Donji Grad neighbourhood of Zemun. The monastery was officially established in 1990.
